rawPolicy: Exact connector-decoded string encoded as UTF-8; BOM and original line endings retained. Original HTTP archive bytes are not available from this connector.
timingLimit: startedAt/endedAt are jobs-API step bounds at source precision. Individual command process start/end and duration are not claimed, including subcommands sharing a step.
exitBasis: Final fixed Node verification command emitted its custody summary; explicit LASTEXITCODE guard and successful step establish exit 0. Staging shell built-ins are preserved in the observed script, not invented as separate processes. Single-command step completed successfully in the jobs API.
executableBasis: Exact invoked command name; a resolved pnpm/Python executable path is not claimed.
cwdBasis: Checkout working-directory line observed in this job; selected script contains no directory change.
